examShortTricks: Trick 1: Haldane lists needs in tiers: work worth doing, freedom, health, companionship — answer 'what does he require?' by the list, not by summary.
Trick 2: The scientist's angle: he demands opportunity for RESEARCH and rational discussion — distinguish his intellectual needs from material ones.
Trick 3: Compare-and-contrast question: Haldane's wants vs an ordinary citizen's — both need freedom and work, but he adds science; state the overlap and difference.
practiceQuestions: Q. What does Haldane require from life? (3 marks) — meaningful work, freedom, health, friendship and scope for science.
Q. Which of Haldane's requirements do you share? Give reasons. (2 marks) — pick one (e.g. meaningful work) and justify personally.
keyPoints: A scientist's demands: work, freedom and companionship — list them explicitly.
Haldane values rational living; connect his demands to wartime context.
